snippet.title: Militsioner - Demo Launch Trailer | The Triple-i Initiative
snippet.description:
Learn more about Militsioner: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1373530/Militsioner/

Militsioner is getting its first public demo, out today on Steam. 
Find the way out, find out who you are.

Every move you make is being followed by a Colossal Policeman. Anger, flatter, disappoint, deceive or even romance him to escape in this surreal immersive sim.

Militsioner Store Pages:
Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1373530/Militsioner/
XBOX: https://www.xbox.com/en-US/games/store/militsioner/9pkxd85nd7h5

What is the Triple-i Initiative?

We’re simply a bunch of studios banding together to share exciting news to our players, in a short show packed with back-to-back trailers. That’s it - no extra fluff, no ads, no host, just games. We’re talking world premieres, exclusive gameplay, launch dates, demo drops and more!
